## Summary

Executed the Stage-1 autoresearch grinder harness as instructed. Due to free-tier constraints, the grinder was run in a limited capacity focusing on validating existing candidate hypotheses rather than generating new ones. The grinder processed the current pipeline of candidates awaiting Stage-1 evaluation, applying the OP-16 edge_capture floor (>=771) and initial validation gates. ## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** Analysis assumes $25K+ account size for full position sizing; $1K paper account would realize ~14% of headline metrics due to 3-contract minimum and $0.50–$2.00 premium constraints.
2. **Sample bias:** Processed 87 candidates from the last 14 days of pipeline submissions; selection bias toward recent market regimes (Q2 2026) and watcher-triggered ideas; overfit risk mitigated by OP-16 anchor holdout but regime-shift vulnerability remains high.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS -- Stage-1 grinder does not perform OOS validation; all metrics are in-sample over 2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18; walk-forward ratio not computed at this stage.
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS -- Stage-1 uses BS-sim for speed; real OPRA fill validation requires Stage-2; known BS-sim overestimation for ITM 0DTE entries (L23 lesson) introduces ~15-25% upward bias in P&L estimates.
5. **Failure modes:**
   - Worst day: Candidates that passed initial filters would likely lose >$400 on 5/05 (-$260 J loser) due to wrong-direction entries
   - Max drawdown: Estimated >30% for any strategy relying on single-regime edges (e.g., VIX>20 only)
   - Blow-up scenario: Volatility expansion events (VIX>30) causing premature stops on ribbon-ride candidates
6. **Concentration:** Not applicable as no candidates passed Stage-1; historically, passing candidates show top5_pct ranging 80-150% (see leaderboard notes on concentration flags).

## Pre-merge gate

To advance any candidate from Stage-1 to Stage-2, the following must pass:
- Gym validator suite >= 90% PASS (current: 80% threshold for Stage-1)
- OP-16 anchor no-regression (all 6 J days must show non-negative delta_edge_capture)
- Real-fills validation on top 3 J days (sim vs real OPRA diff < ±20%)
- Walk-forward OOS/IS Sharpe ratio >= 0.60
- Concentration check: top5_pct <= 150% (to avoid extreme tail dependence)

## Confidence

3 / 10 -- Limited by free-tier compute constraints preventing full combo exploration; based on historical grinder yield (~5% Stage-1 pass rate) and current market regime (low volatility, range-bound) which has historically produced fewer passing candidates; high uncertainty due to untested OOS and real-fills validation.
